snippet.title: Max Cross - Official Trailer #1 - Out Now! Download FREE on Steam
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4943790/Max_Cross/

Run. Gun. Squawk. Survive.

Meet Max Cross — the world's most dangerous half-man, half-albatross.

Blast your way through an endless barrage of enemies. Absurd cartoon chaos in this fast-paced arcade run-and-gun adventure. 
Inspired by arcade classics, Max Cross throws you into procedurally generated levels where every run is a new challenge.

No two runs are the same, good luck...

Wishlist Now!
